name: Zebra Internet
summary: 'Black and white Internet with no hidden catches' — dialup + ADSL ISP (~2003); defunct (Saunders Properties Pty. Limited, ACN 083 037 772).

events.details: Defunct. Current c.2006 is wrong - Zebra Internet was demonstrably retailing ADSL through Dec 2008-Sep 2009 (last retail ISP homepage 12 Sep 2009); per the last-retail-homepage convention death is c.2009 (proposal's c.2010 cannot be distinguished by any capture before 2023), and the live 2026 site is a revival by a different operator. last ISP homepage Sep 2009. zebrainternet.com.au returned from Dec 2024 as a revival by the unrelated Ultimate Communication Solutions Pty Ltd (UltimateBroadband) — does not extend this record.

refs.label: Last genuine retail ISP homepage for the original Zebra Internet operation, 12 Sep 2009.
Confirms the ISP was trading into early 2009 and was already going unresponsive by Mar 2009; thread then dies.
No Wayback captures at all between Sep 2009 and Aug 2023, i.e. the original ISP site simply vanished; hard evidence cannot separate 2009 from 2010.
Domain revived by a different operator (Ultimate Communication Solutions) showing UltimateBroadband branding in Dec 2024.
Decisive: the ISP's own contact page prints ABN 97 083 037 772
ABR history verified: ZEBRA INTERNET name spans exactly the ISP's c.2003-c.2006 life, at Port Macquarie NSW 2444 matching the site's postal address
